drowned.name: The Drowned Kingdom
drowned.blurb: A cathedral kingdom at the bottom of the sea. The bells still ring for the drowned.
drowned.lead: Water seeps under the first door, and bells ring in the crypt at night. The Prior sends the first company down.

rime.name: The Sundered Rime
rime.blurb: A glacier split open by the fire beneath. Everything here is half frozen and half burning, and it cracks.
rime.lead: The fleet's charts end at a white sea and a glacier with fire beneath it. The leviathan was fleeing that heat.

foundry.name: The Storm Foundry
foundry.blurb: A forge built inside a thunderhead. The smiths hammer lightning into bronze and do not stop to eat or sleep.
foundry.lead: Every powder cart went to one buyer: a foundry in the clouds. The Canary Priests sang its name to the gas.

baths.name: The Boiling Baths
baths.blurb: A temple of baths where the nobility came to be cleansed. The water never stopped heating.
baths.lead: The fen hags sold their black mud to a temple of baths as a cure. The Mire Mother's head is still warm. Something upstream is boiling.

pits.name: The Sulphur Pits
pits.blurb: Brimstone mines where the air itself will burn. The miners stopped breathing long ago.
pits.lead: The baths were never heated with wood. Their furnaces burned brimstone, carted up from the pits below.

pyre.name: The Black Pyre
pyre.blurb: A cathedral where the saints were burned and refused to finish. The fire here is black and gives no light.
pyre.lead: The Frozen Saints died praying toward a black flame. They were pilgrims, fleeing a cathedral where saints were burned.

spire.name: The Stilled Spire
spire.blurb: An observatory where the astronomers tried to stop time. They succeeded, mostly. The clocks still tick inside the ice.
spire.lead: Pilgrims crossed the hive plain to an observatory, to watch the stars stop. Some of them are still walking.

fleet.name: The Icebound Fleet
fleet.blurb: A war fleet frozen into a white sea, mid-battle. The crews are still at their posts.
fleet.lead: The wreckers' ledger lists every ship they took, and the one fleet they let pass: a war fleet sailing north to kill a leviathan.

barrow.name: The Hollow Barrow
barrow.blurb: Burial mounds of a plague-struck kingdom, kept fresh by the cold. The dead are not rotten. They are preserved, plague and all.
barrow.lead: The Jarl's hold buried its plague dead in barrows beyond the ice. The Riven Jarl wore a barrow-lord's ring.

silence.name: The White Silence
silence.blurb: A tundra under a black star. Nothing makes a sound here. Nothing warm has ever lived.
silence.lead: The Last Hour's hand points at one star: the one the astronomers stopped time to keep from falling. It fell.

coast.name: The Stormwrack Coast
coast.blurb: Cliffs where the storm never ends, and the wreckers light false lights to bring the ships in.
coast.lead: The foundry cast bells for the sea-kingdoms. Its storm broke loose and drifted out over the coast, and it has not stopped since.

hive.name: The Venom Spires
hive.blurb: Hive towers on a lightning-struck plain. The insects that build them sting with venom that stops the heart.
hive.lead: The Barrow King's plague came up the trade road from the south, inside a traveller who moved when the larvae did.

sky.name: The Torn Sky
sky.blurb: A heaven torn open by a war of gods. The ruins float in the storm, and through the tears something looks in.
sky.lead: Every eye in the garden looks up. The Antlered Mother's roots grow toward a tear in the sky.

mire.name: The Rotmire
mire.blurb: A drowned fen where the water is poison and the bodies in it do not rot. The hags keep house on stilts.
mire.lead: The Drowned King's crown is packed with fen peat. The tide that took his kingdom still runs inland, to a poison fen.

garden.name: The Blighted Garden
garden.blurb: A fey garden gone to rot. The spores grow minds, and the minds grow wrong.
garden.lead: The Saint Unending was burned for one sermon: that heaven was a garden, and a woman kept it. Her ash still drifts toward it.
